title: Integration test: two-peer tip propagation and reconciliation
description:
Spin up two transit daemon instances in the test, connect them, have node A append 20 entries to a group log, and verify node B receives all tip advertisements and can initiate backfill to obtain all 20 entries. Test runs in-process with test doubles for IPFS. Artifact: transit/tests/gossip_propagation.rs.

Acceptance criteria:
- Node B receives TipAdvertisement from A within 5 seconds
- Node B successfully backfills all 20 entries via parent-link traversal
- Test is deterministic (fixed peer IDs, seeded entropy)
- Test passes with 'cargo test' without any external process
